subject: Initial and last-used states of data
notes: LANDED 2026-09-02 (PB152). Action 1 is the consumer point 11.9.10.4 GR2/GR3/GR4 route to, and its ORDER against action 2 is structural: the fill is a BACKGROUND laid down first and then OVERWRITTEN by VALUE clauses, never a per-item substitute for a missing VALUE. pb152_options_initialize_background pins the ordering with an item that HAS a VALUE beside one that does not. No sequencing code was added - a field initializer is one expression, and only the expression's no-VALUE case changed - so the re-application sites (RecordStructEmitter's field initializers and __ResetStatics, the LOCAL-STORAGE per-activation re-seed, the OO instance cell) inherit it by construction. DETERMINATION recorded in CONFORMANCE.md and DATA_MODEL_DESIGN D23: 'the storage ... is set to the specified-fill-character' over a typed-native model means CHARACTER-FORMED storage takes the fill, while a NATIVE-NUMERIC carrier and an INDEX cell take their zero - licensed by 13.18.63.4 GR4 c), whose own sentence leaves a VALUE-less item 'undefined and set to a value that may or may not be allowed for that data item or index'. Class object/message-tag/pointer take NULL instead, because that same sentence states it as a positive requirement; USAGE BIT keeps its packed ceil(n/8) zero seed (D19) because its storage is packed bytes rather than character positions.
